sources.name: Københavns Universitet - Universitetshospitalet for Familiedyr (dyrehospitalet.ku.dk)
sources.note: Official university hospital: Emergency Room open 24/7 incl. weekends and holidays, phone +45 35 33 29 30. Also /english/about-hospital/opening-hours/.

sources.name: Den Danske Dyrlægeforening (ddd.dk) - list of approved training clinics 29.08.2023 (PDF)
sources.note: Official association list: names and addresses only, no phones and no 24-h marks. Used for names/addresses; phones taken from the BOAS list or the clinics' own pages.

sources.name: Den Danske Dyrlægeforening (ddd.dk) - approved BOAS vets 01.06.2025 (PDF)
sources.note: Official association list with clinic name, address and phone; no 24-h marks.

sources.name: AniCura Danmark - Akut dyrlæge og dyrlægevagt døgnet rundt
sources.note: Chain page: six hospitals listed as 'Døgnåben skadestue', receive acute patients 'hele døgnet'. Also /akutklinikker/ (Akut 00-24 / limited akut hours for Roskilde and Skovlunde). No animal poison line; only 'mistanke om forgiftning' as a reason to call an emergency vet.

sources.name: Evidensia Danmark - Dyrlægevagt & Akut Dyrlæge
sources.note: Chain page: Karlslunde 24-h hospital, Kolding/Trekant 24-h duty cooperation, North Zealand on-call (not 24 h), horse/farm duty.

sources.name: VetGruppen - clinic duty (vagt/døgnvagt) pages
sources.note: Own pages of Nykøbing F, Helsingør, Skive, Esbjerg. Several other vetgruppen.dk pages (Brønderslev døgnvagt, Aarhus Nordre vagt, Risskov, Frederikshavn kontakt, Ikast, Sorø, Gørlev) returned fetch errors and were not used.

sources.name: Visit Vesterhavet - find veterinarian (tourism body, West Jutland coast)
sources.note: Seven vets on the North Sea coast with phone and address; Dyrlæge Center Vest described as round-the-clock service.

sources.name: Individual clinic websites (opened with WebFetch 2026-11-03)
sources.note: Dyrlægegården Rønne, Bindslev Dyrehospital Skagen, Vodskov Dyreklinik, Storehavelse Dyreklinik; each entry's source_url is the page used.

entries.name: Universitetshospitalet for Familiedyr (KU Sund) - Akutmodtagelse
entries.duty: Emergency Room and on-call veterinarian reachable 24/7 on the same number, incl. weekends and public holidays. Daytime appointments Mon-Fri 8:30-15:30.

duty_i18n.sl: Urgenca in dežurni veterinar sta dosegljiva 24 ur na dan na isti številki, tudi ob koncih tedna in praznikih. Naročanje čez dan pon–pet 8.30–15.30.

entries.name: AniCura Københavns Dyrehospital
entries.duty: Emergency room open every day around the clock (00–24); clinic weekdays 8–16. Call before arrival.

duty_i18n.sl: Urgenca je odprta vsak dan 24 ur na dan (0–24); klinika ob delavnikih 8–16. Pred prihodom pokličite.

entries.quote: Skadestuen er åben 24 timer i døgnet.

entries.name: AniCura Køge Dyrehospital
entries.duty: Emergency room open 24 h; call before arrival. Daytime 8–18.

duty_i18n.sl: Urgenca odprta 24 ur na dan; pred prihodom pokličite. Podnevi 8–18.

entries.note: Listed as 'Døgnåben skadestue - ring før ankomst'.

entries.name: Evidensia Karlslunde Dyrehospital - Døgnåben skadestue
entries.duty: Emergency line 77 77 77 11; general 46 15 15 25. Emergency room Mon 18–08, Tue–Fri 17–08, Sat–Sun 08–08; hospital open 24 h every day. Call before coming.

duty_i18n.sl: Linija za nujne primere 77 77 77 11; splošna številka 46 15 15 25. Urgenca pon 18–8, tor–pet 17–8, sob–ned 8–8; bolnišnica odprta vsak dan 24 ur na dan. Pred prihodom pokličite.

entries.quote: Dyrehospitalet i Karlslunde har åbent 24 timer i døgnet - også i weekender og på helligdage.

entries.name: AniCura Odense Dyrehospital
entries.duty: 24-h emergency room all days of the year; phone reaches the duty vet at any time. Regular consultations weekdays 8–16. Call before coming.

duty_i18n.sl: 24-urna urgenca vse dni v letu; po telefonu je dežurni veterinar dosegljiv kadar koli. Redni pregledi ob delavnikih 8–16. Pred prihodom pokličite.

entries.name: AniCura Varde Dyrehospital
entries.duty: Emergency room open 24 h; call before arrival. Daytime 8–17.

duty_i18n.sl: Urgenca odprta 24 ur na dan; pred prihodom pokličite. Podnevi 8–17.

entries.note: Listed as 'Døgnåben skadestue - ring før ankomst'.

entries.name: AniCura Aarhus Dyrehospital
entries.duty: Emergency room open around the clock, all year; call first. Regular hours Mon-Fri 08:00-17:00.

duty_i18n.sl: Urgenca odprta 24 ur na dan, vse leto; najprej pokličite. Redni urnik pon–pet 8–17.

entries.quote: Vi tilbyder en 24-timers vagtservice året rundt
entries.note: The quote is from AniCura Aarhus' referral magazine (anicura.dk/globalassets/anicura_aarhus_dyrehospital_henvisningsmagasin_2024-2025-.pdf); the chain page above also lists it as 'Døgnåben skadestue'.

entries.name: AniCura Familiedyrlægerne Aalborg (Svenstrup)
entries.duty: Emergency room open 24 h; call before arrival. Daytime 8–16:30.

duty_i18n.sl: Urgenca odprta 24 ur na dan; pred prihodom pokličite. Podnevi 8–16.30.

entries.note: Listed as 'Døgnåben skadestue - ring før ankomst'.

entries.name: AniCura Dyrehospitalet City Syd
entries.duty: Duty vet outside regular hours on the same number; acutely ill or injured animals can be treated 'hele døgnet' (around the clock).

duty_i18n.sl: Dežurni veterinar izven rednega delovnega časa na isti številki; akutno bolne ali poškodovane hišne ljubljenčke lahko obravnavajo „hele døgnet“ (24 ur na dan).

entries.note: Page does not state 24 h hours explicitly.

entries.name: AniCura Roskilde Dyrehospital (fhv. Himmelev Dyreklinik)
entries.duty: Emergency 8–23; regular hours 8–17.

duty_i18n.sl: Nujna pomoč 8–23; redni urnik 8–17.

entries.name: AniCura Skovlunde Dyrehospital
entries.duty: Emergency 8–17 only.

duty_i18n.sl: Nujna pomoč samo 8–17.

entries.name: Trekant vagtsamarbejde (Evidensia Kolding Dyrehospital + 6 clinics)
entries.duty: Call 75 52 23 33 and you are connected to the vet on duty in the Trekant area, 24 h incl. weekends and public holidays. On-call: a vet is not always on site; agree time and place by phone.

duty_i18n.sl: Pokličite 75 52 23 33 in povezali vas bodo z dežurnim veterinarjem na območju Trekant, 24 ur na dan, tudi ob koncih tedna in praznikih. Dežurstvo: veterinar ni vedno v ambulanti; uro in kraj dogovorite po telefonu.

entries.quote: Sammen passer vi vagten 24 timer i døgnet, også i weekender og på helligdage.

entries.name: Evidensia Kolding Dyrehospital
entries.duty: Opening hours Mon 8-18, Tue-Fri 8-17, closed weekends; after hours see the Trekant duty cooperation entry.

duty_i18n.sl: Delovni čas pon 8–18, tor–pet 8–17, ob koncih tedna zaprto; izven delovnega časa glejte vnos dežurnega sodelovanja Trekant.

entries.name: Evidensia tilkaldevagt Nordsjælland (Slotsbyens + Dahlgaard Dyreklinik)
entries.duty: On-call Thu–Fri 17:00–22:30 and Sat 8:00–17:00; a vet is not necessarily on site, call to arrange time and place.

duty_i18n.sl: Dežurstvo čet–pet 17–22.30 in sob 8–17; veterinar ni nujno v ambulanti, za dogovor o uri in kraju pokličite.

entries.note: Addresses from the DDD training-clinic list; phone and hours from the Evidensia page. No 24-h wording.

entries.name: Helsingør Dyrehospital - after-hours via Birkerød Dyrehospital (VetGruppen)
entries.duty: Daytime Helsingør +45 49 20 30 16 (Mon–Thu 8–17, Fri 8–16); after hours call Birkerød Dyrehospital +45 81 81 89 81, where you can always reach a vet (Birkerød offers round-the-clock duty).

duty_i18n.sl: Podnevi Helsingør +45 49 20 30 16 (pon–čet 8–17, pet 8–16); izven delovnega časa pokličite Birkerød Dyrehospital +45 81 81 89 81, kjer je veterinar vedno dosegljiv (Birkerød ima dežurstvo 24 ur na dan).

entries.note: Page body names Birkerød +45 81 81 89 81 for after hours; the number 70 22 33 07 appears only in the page meta description and is not used.

entries.name: Storehavelse Dyreklinik - akut dyrlægevagt
entries.duty: Duty weekdays 17-22 and weekends 8-22 by the clinic's own vet; 'as far as possible' around the clock, otherwise referral to Karlslunde Dyrehospital.

duty_i18n.sl: Dežurstvo ob delavnikih 17–22 in ob koncih tedna 8–22 opravlja veterinar ambulante; „kolikor je mogoče“ 24 ur na dan, sicer napotitev v Karlslunde Dyrehospital.

entries.name: Nykøbing F. Dyrehospital - døgnvagt (with Guldborgsund Dyrehospital)
entries.duty: Duty vet reachable outside opening hours (Mon–Thu 8–17, Fri 8–16) on the same number; on-call arrangement with Guldborgsund Dyrehospital; 100 % duty surcharge.

duty_i18n.sl: Dežurni veterinar je izven delovnega časa (pon–čet 8–17, pet 8–16) dosegljiv na isti številki; dogovor o dežurstvu z Guldborgsund Dyrehospital; 100-odstotno doplačilo za dežurstvo.

entries.name: Dyrlægevagt Skive / Morsø / Herning (Dyrehospitalet Heden)
entries.duty: Call 97 51 30 45 to reach the vet on duty: from closing time to 22:00 Skive Dyrehospital, Morsø Dyreklinik and Dyrehospitalet Heden take turns; 22:00–08:00 Dyrehospitalet Heden, Herning.

duty_i18n.sl: Za dežurnega veterinarja pokličite 97 51 30 45: od zaprtja do 22. ure se izmenjujejo Skive Dyrehospital, Morsø Dyreklinik in Dyrehospitalet Heden; 22–8 Dyrehospitalet Heden, Herning.

entries.note: Gap 08:00-opening not stated; no explicit 24-h wording.

entries.name: Dyrehospitalet Heden
entries.duty: Covers the night duty 22:00–08:00 for the Skive/Morsø/Herning duty rota.

duty_i18n.sl: Pokriva nočno dežurstvo 22–8 za dežurni razpored Skive/Morsø/Herning.

entries.name: Vodskov Dyreklinik - dyrlægevagt Aalborg-området
entries.duty: On-call weekdays 17:00–08:00, weekends from Friday 17:00 to Monday 08:00 and public holidays; call the main number to be told which vet is on duty.

duty_i18n.sl: Dežurstvo ob delavnikih 17–8, ob koncih tedna od petka 17 do ponedeljka 8 in ob praznikih; pokličite glavno številko, da izveste, kateri veterinar je dežuren.

entries.name: Dyrlægegården Bornholm
entries.duty: 24-h on-call for acutely injured animals on the same number; open Mon–Fri 8–17 (closed 12–13). On-call service, not necessarily staffed on site.

duty_i18n.sl: 24-urno dežurstvo za akutno poškodovane hišne ljubljenčke na isti številki; odprto pon–pet 8–17 (zaprto 12–13). Dežurna služba, ni nujno, da je nekdo v ambulanti.

entries.name: Bindslev Dyrehospital - klinik Skagen
entries.duty: Mon-Fri weekday hours only (e.g. Tue 08:30-16:30); outside opening hours calls are forwarded to Bindslev Dyrehospital. Larger examinations and surgery in Bindslev.

duty_i18n.sl: Samo ob delavnikih pon–pet (npr. tor 8.30–16.30); izven delovnega časa se klici preusmerijo v Bindslev Dyrehospital. Obsežnejši pregledi in operacije v Bindslevu.

entries.name: Dyrlæge Center Vest (VetGruppen)
entries.duty: Call to confirm hours.

duty_i18n.sl: Delovni čas potrdite po telefonu.

entries.note: A regional tourism page says "The hospital offers round-the-clock service"; not confirmed on the clinic's own or an official page, so not listed as 24 h.

entries.name: Esbjerg Dyrehospital (VetGruppen, Tarp)

duty_i18n.sl: Pon–pet 8–17.

entries.note: Page links to a general 'Dyrlægevagt' page (vetgruppen.dk/dyrlaegevagt/) that was not opened.

notes: Poison lines: none found. The only poison-related page opened (AniCura dyrlægevagt) merely lists 'mistanke om forgiftning' as a reason to call an emergency vet; no Danish animal poison information line was found on an official page (Giftlinjen is for humans). Not reachable/not used: dyrlaegevagten.dk, anicura.dk, ddd.dk root and evidensia.dk root (not fetchable directly, only URLs surfaced by search); vetgruppen.dk pages for Brønderslev døgnvagt, Aarhus Nordre dyrlægevagt, Risskov akut, Frederikshavn kontakt, Ikast vagt, Sorø vagt, Gørlev vagt (fetch errors); skagenonline.dk FAQ (fetch error). The DDD practice finder / vagtordning page was not reachable, so no association-run duty rota was found; Denmark has no national duty rota - after-hours cover is organised by chains and local clinic groups (see entries). Phones for clinics sourced from the DDD BOAS list were not re-verified on the clinics' own sites. Aalborg: Aalborg Dyrehospital (Fredrikstadsvej 10, 9200 Aalborg SV), Dyrehospitalet 9000 (Hobrovej 38-40) and AniCura Dyrehospital Nørresundby (Thistedvej 36) are in the DDD list without phone/site and were omitted. Left to research: Frederikshavn Dyrehospital, Hjørring, Thisted, Holstebro, Silkeborg, Horsens, Vejle, Fredericia, Svendborg, Sønderborg/Gråsten/Aabenraa/Alsia, Haderslev, Slagelse, Næstved, Faxe, Hillerød clinics, Lyngby, Odense small clinics (Overgades, Dyrenes Klinik, Skibhus), Copenhagen small clinics (Østerbro, Amagerbrogade, Frederiksberg), Brønderslev/Jerslev døgnvagt. Hours are as published on the cited pages on 2026-11-03.
